metadata.description: Small Claude Code mods for keeping an eye on context and usage limits

plugins.name: context-label
plugins.description: The context window's fill always shown in the prompt footer, beside the model name: a four-square bar colored by level, then ctx 23% · 228k/1M

plugins.name: limit-band
plugins.description: A thin line above the prompt for the 5-hour usage limit, colored by pace (where it would end at the current rate), with its time to reset, a tick at the window's clock and the 7-day limit beside it
